body.message:
I’m not able to give you a definite answer just yet, but I’ll get back to you later.

Could you please let me know whether the utilities and DEWA are included in the rent?

I don’t have a car, so if the rent can be fixed for three months, I would be happy to rent the apartment for those three months. After that, if we can agree on the price, I would be interested in extending the rental.

Also, could you please send me a couple of recent photos of the apartment?
